measurement_mode: CV source slots minus a shared background slot
residual_model: fixed, zero-spatial-mean source-separated field discrepancy per source and realization; applied after background subtraction; sensitivity assumption, not measured temporal noise or raw static sensor offset
notes: All output fields and localization estimates are synthetic.
Reference geometries and source moments are frozen inputs. Their measured origins are documented in simulation_parameters.json.
Noise is an assumed per-axis raw-slot standard deviation, not a value estimated from the archived acquisitions.
Source moments remain fixed over the distance scan.
The legacy recorded domain contains simulations at fixed reference geometries, not experimental localization results.
The point-dipole model is used. Higher-order source terms are not included.
